verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only bare doc titles for a "Hints" page [kitty-docs-17] and a page on "customizing the matching and actions of the kitten" [kitty-docs-14]. These suggest a kitten that matches text in output and acts on it, which could cover keyboard selection, but no item describes what it matches or what it does. Nothing in the pack mentions clicking URLs or file paths with the mouse. Missing for 10: any description of what the hints kitten matches (URLs, paths) and does with them, any evidence of mouse-click opening of URLs or paths, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
